title: 約15億年前からコンニチハ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way home after some errands, Gold Ship gestures to me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's this park! This is where we bumped into the princess, remember?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Man, that day was so fun! It was the total package: a tale of love, war, and tears!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It sure was a shocker though—hearing that she came from the future to save our planet from those green beasties.
choice_data_list: Is it just me, or did you change her backstory?
Is it just me, or did you change her backstory?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What are those kids doin' stuck together like a flock of sheep?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And hold up… Isn't that the princess in the middle?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Have you heard the stuff this weirdo's always muttering to herself?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah! The other day, I saw her drawing a bunch of stuff in the sandbox and saying she was "doing magic"!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: That's sooo weird. Aren't you a little old to be playing pretend?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Wh-what do you care, anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to be in a tough spot.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, geez… I swear, kids can be so mean.
choice_data_list: Are you going to tell them off?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? You mean like march over there and tell them to knock it off? That'll just make them act even worse.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Anyone sticking their nose in someone else's beeswax like that is just bored, guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And there's only one way to kick boredom in the butt!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Watch and learn!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: One, two…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, Gold Ship leaps up, arcs through the sky, and sticks the landing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: THREEEEE!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Ack! What was that?!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Who're you?! An Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh… It's been 700 million years since we last met…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I've been hunting you down since the Sturtian ice age, and now you're finally within my grasp!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Prepare yourself! We end this once and for all, here and now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship gives me a look, indicating that it's my turn to speak. I clear my throat and take up my role.
choice_data_list: Heh, once I escape to the future, you'll never catch me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Hey, brats! What're you standing around for?! Run and hide or something! Get the heck outta here!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Umm? What are you people talking about?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, for cryin' out loud! Do you want to get eaten for dinner?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Look, in like three seconds, this baddie's head is gonna pop open and another mouth is gonna slither out to swallow you whole!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You really gonna stand there to see it happen? Here it comes in three! Two! One!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Uh?! R-run awaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The kids get totally absorbed in Gold Ship's improvised story and have a blast running around until they're exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Today… was actually kinda fun…

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Yeah! I haven't run around like that in forever!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha! Did you have a good time, kiddos?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Look, if the world ever gets too boring for you, it's up to you to spice things up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wait, that was pretty profound, wasn't it? Think I'll get nominated for a super special URA commendation for that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer! I'm ready for my reward! I won't ask for much, but special permission to live on Mars would be a good start!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sun sets on our eventful day with Gold Ship's giddy bursts of laughter echoing through the air.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I won't let you get away this time! All right, then…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, brats! Follow me into the forest! That's where the baddie's time machine is stashed!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Forest? Are you seriously calling the overgrown bushes over there a forest?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Forget that, time machines aren't even real!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Man, you kids really don't know the right way to play in a forest, do you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heck, I bet you don't even know how to enjoy a nice hike in the woods!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Good thing you've got me to teach you how to be one with nature! Now shush and follow me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Look under that tree! Do you see the time machine part buried over there?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Pffft, don't be ridiculous. There's no way anything is under there.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Hm? Wait, hang on a second! There really is something! See?

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: Ewww! This box smells disgusting!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoopsies, my bad. That's the yakisoba sammy I buried when I was trying to grow a sandwich tree.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yuck! Why's it that color?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, no need to get all worked up about it. We'll find the treasure buried in these woods for sure! The pirate treasure, that is!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Weren't we looking for a time machine?!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, the kids follow Gold Ship's (questionable) lead on a grand treasure hunt in the woods.
